text:
maya: Quick sanity bakeoff summary for the new fp8+awq hybrid we profiled. posting highlights and a proposed rollforward for hosted/dedicated/private.

ash: nice, high level first?

maya: TL;DR — quality deltas tiny on our golden set (avg -0.4% BLEU-equivalent), but there are edge-case regressions on long-context code completion (narrow, reproducible). Latency p95 increased ~18% on hosted (due to kernel path), but cost per token down ~34%.

devon: can you drop the main numbers?

maya: sure:
- dataset: 10k eval mix (golden dialogs + code long-tail + retrieval-augmented QAs)
- fp16 baseline: p95 180ms, token cost $0.010
- fp8+awq variant: p95 212ms, token cost $0.0066
- avg quality delta vs fp16: -0.4% (mostly in code long-tail), 95th percentile regression bucket shows -2.2% on 120 examples

priya: is the -2.2% concentrated on a single prompt family?

maya: yes — long code generation with repetitive variable names and deeply nested loops. I attached examples in the eval harness. Not a hallucination class, more pattern degradation.

caroline: are those examples failing automated acceptance (goldenset) now?

maya: only 8/10k cross the regression alert threshold. Our current quality gate is 1.5% per-slice, so they fail the slice gate but not global.

ash: thoughts on rollout profile? I propose a staged rollforward: hosted canary -> dedicated staged -> private opt-in. details:
```
hosted: canary 1% (48h) -> 5% (72h) -> 20% (7d) -> full
dedicated: start as opt-in for reserved pools, run perf profile for 2w then 50% traffic for non-critical routes
private: customers get a preview build + migration guide, off by default
quality gates: global delta <1.0% and no slice >1.5% at each stage -> otherwise rollback
```

devon: we should add a fallback knob: route to fp16 or to awq-int8 if a request matches a flagged prompt family. cheap prefix classifier maybe.

maya: agreed. suggested fallback policy snippet: 
```
{"fallback_policy": [{"match":"code_long_nesting","route":"fp16","max_retries":0},{"match":"default","route":"quant_variant","max_retries":1}]}
```

priya: how do we detect the flagged prompt family in prod without heavy compute?

maya: simple heuristic classifier: token pattern regex + model length > 400. we already have that as a lightweight Lua filter in the edge router. devon will add a small perf test.

devon: will add perf test and a small binary classifier (50k param) if regex is insufficient. cheap to run at edge.

caroline: monitoring + alerting? need runbooks.

maya: dashboards: per-variant goldenset score, per-slice regression counts, p95 latency, cost per token. Automated rollback triggers: 
- any slice >1.5% regression AND at least 5 confirmed cases in 24h
- p95 latency increase >30% absolute (vs baseline)
- error rate increase >0.2%

sre-bot: deploy-check triggered: hosted canary cluster has capacity for 1% traffic. autoscaler thresholds at 60% gpu util.

ash: allocation across environments: hosted first because we can do fine-grained traffic splits. dedicated needs an opt-in window because reserved kernels may differ (some A100 pools prefer gptq path).

maya: note — dedicated perf numbers differ: on A100 pools awq path p95 ~190ms vs 212ms on hosted (we think hosted NVL kernels less optimized for awq). keep dedicated param: run 2-week perf soak before shifting production traffic.

priya: whats the rollback latency? how fast can we flip the whole canary back to fp16?

maya: flip is immediate at routing layer (seconds). draining + cache warming takes ~10–15 minutes before p95 stabilizes.

devon: we should also stage quant variant names in model catalog: e.g., model-x.fp8-awq.v1, model-x.awq-int8.v1 — so routing and metrics stay clear.

caroline: request: add a short eval checklist for private customers (on-prem) so they can run the same goldenset locally before enabling.

maya: will draft and add to the private onboarding repo. checklist items: kernel compatibility, KV cache benchmarks, goldenset run, smoke prompting for edgecases.

ash: everyone OK with the staged plan? we need signoff to schedule the hosted canary for next Tue.

priya: +1 from QA, will monitor slice alerts.

devon: +1, will push classifier perf tests and the fallback router rule.

caroline: +1, will write the private onboarding checklist.

sre-bot: scheduled: hosted-canary job queued for 2026-03-24T08:00Z (estimated run 4h).

maya: thanks — I'll open the rollout PR with the policy JSON and attach the failing examples for traceability.

ash: add the cost impact note to the PR: expected monthly token cost reduction ~34% for quant variant; we want finance to validate P&L for Dedicated renewals.

maya: PR link in thread when ready. :rocket:
